name: Dermatologist

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Skin check
services.story: The main story: a yearly skin check with Elena, $179 on the list. Nothing is taken. The desk checks Alex's plan, and Alex pays the share at the front desk.

services.name: Problem visit
services.story: A $140 problem visit where the office turns on its $20 no-show fee. A card is saved for it, and the owner confirms any charge.

services.name: Botox (10 units)
services.story: Botox, 10 units: $140, self-pay. A $40 deposit on the secure page counts toward it, and Alex pays the $100 rest at the front desk.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Ravi (nurse practitioner) and Marco (physician assistant), who see patients at home or in a care home

services.name: Skin check at home
services.story: The main story: a $179 skin check at Alex's home, billed to Alex's plan. Nothing is taken, and the office bills the plan its own way.

services_shape: visit types with set lengths, each with a clinician by name; medical visits are billed to the patient's health plan or paid by the patient; cosmetic visits are paid by the patient; anything added at the visit, like a biopsy, needs the patient's yes first
questions_before_times: which visit: the office's own visit types only, never a symptom or a spot typed into the AI
a health plan (its name only) or paying yourself
for a video visit: the state the patient will be in
join the list for a sooner time
safety_stop: swelling of the face, lips, tongue or throat, or trouble breathing (for example after a new medicine or a shot)
a fast-spreading rash with blisters, peeling skin or a high fever
bleeding that won't stop after 20 minutes of firm pressure
swallowed a skin medicine, or too much of one
first_steps: A referral from the primary care doctor
A written price estimate for self-pay and cosmetic patients
A cosmetic consult before a first filler
license: always: each dermatologist (MD or DO), physician assistant and nurse practitioner who sees patients holds their own active license from the state where the patient is during the visit, video included
staff_skills: dermatologists: every visit, biopsies, cosmetic injections; physician assistants and nurse practitioners: skin checks, problem visits, biopsies, and cosmetic injections where the state allows and the practice lists them; medical assistants and the front desk: no clinical OKs
messages_never: texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the plan, a referral, the reason, a spot, photos or results; flow A's texts drop the clinician's name; at the patient's home or care home the clinician's name stays, for the door check
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
